STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_05119_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_05119_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_05119 (
    address,
    begintransfer,
    clk,
    read,
    reset_n,
    write,
    writedata,
    LCD_E,
    LCD_RS,
    LCD_RW,
    LCD_data,
    readdata
);

    output          LCD_E;
    output          LCD_RS;
    output          LCD_RW;
    inout   [7:0]	LCD_data;
    output  [7:0]	readdata;
    input   [1:0]	address;
    input           begintransfer;
    input           clk;
    input           read;
    input           reset_n;
    input           write;
    input   [7:0]	writedata;

    wire            LCD_E;
    wire            LCD_RS;
    wire            LCD_RW;
    wire    [7:0]	LCD_data;
    wire    [7:0]	readdata;

    assign LCD_RW = address[0];
    assign LCD_RS = address[1];
    assign LCD_E = read | write;
    assign LCD_data = (address[0]) ? 8'bz : writedata;
    assign readdata = LCD_data;

endmodule
